description: 976 Zone à potentiel éolien is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by carto.observatoire-de-mayotte.fr. At the beginning of 2006, an agreement between the General Council of Mayotte, the University of Orleans and the Encis Wind design firm was signed to assess the wind potential of Mayotte. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "976 Area with wind potential" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include 976, Mayotte, Énergie. The listing shows 2017-02-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
